describes: packages/plugin/render: the tile manager behind tilesFor (engagement, levels, want sets, retention, settle, backpressure).

cases.name: never-engages-below-the-threshold
cases.covers: A thumbnail demand, a demand the base already supplies exactly, an unknown page and a lattice rung that covers the demand all return the empty plan and fetch nothing.

cases.name: lattice-band-tolerance
cases.covers: Under a lattice tiles engage only past 1.25 × the rung the base supplies.

cases.name: engages-past-the-budget
cases.covers: Continuous past the budget: the visible tiles fetch at the exact scale (bled rects, y-up), center-out; arrivals wake the layers once per frame; P1 prefetch starts only when P0 is resolved; the plan is memoized until something changes.

cases.name: center-out-order
cases.covers: Visible tiles fetch nearest the visible center first, ties in row-major order.

cases.name: identity-law-inside-a-rung
cases.covers: Under a lattice the default ×2 pyramid owns tile levels: zoom inside a rung re-plans to the same stamp and fetches nothing.

cases.name: retention-across-a-level-crossing
cases.covers: Zooming in keeps painted coarser tiles in the paint list, stacked under the sharper arrivals, until the covering want tiles report painted; fetch completion alone never releases.

cases.name: zoom-out-keeps-fine-tiles
cases.covers: Zooming out keeps the finer painted tiles above the coarse want until the coarse tiles paint.

cases.name: pan-fetches-only-the-exposed-tiles
cases.covers: Panning at one level fetches the newly exposed tiles, keeps the ones still visible, drops resolved ones that left the want set (bytes stay cached) and re-promotes them from the store on a pan back.

cases.name: abort-when-leaving-the-want-set
cases.covers: In-flight tiles that leave the want set abort at once (the engine sees the store’s reason), free their transit slots, and a late answer changes nothing.

cases.name: epoch-bump-drops-everything
cases.covers: An invalidation makes retained pixels wrong: every entry of the old epoch drops, in-flight ones abort, the settle timer clears, and the want set refetches under the new key.

cases.name: disengage-clears-state
cases.covers: Zooming back under the threshold drops the page’s tile bookkeeping and aborts what is in flight; resolved bytes stay in the store, so re-engaging paints from cache.

cases.name: unpaint-withdraws-coverage
cases.covers: A want tile that leaves the DOM stops counting as coverage: the retained coarse tile stays until it paints again.

cases.name: failure-is-not-retried-at-its-level
cases.covers: A tile that fails (not an abort) wakes the layers and is not refetched at this level; a level change clears the memory and retries it.

cases.name: settle-gate-under-exact
cases.covers: Under exact mode every zoom frame is a new level: first engagement fetches at once, a burst of level changes re-arms one settle timer, and only the final level fetches when it fires.

cases.name: same-pending-level-fires-at-once
cases.covers: Planning the pending level again before the timer fires cancels the timer and fetches immediately.

cases.name: settle-disabled
cases.covers: settleMs 0 disables the gate: a level change fetches at once.

cases.name: views-are-isolated
cases.covers: Tile state is per view × page: a rail’s never-engaging plan leaves the main view untouched, a painted report against the wrong view is a no-op, and the store dedupes bytes across views.

cases.name: release-one-view
cases.covers: Releasing one view’s page aborts only its in-flight consumers: a fetch another view still awaits stays alive, and aborts when the last view lets go.

cases.name: backpressure
cases.covers: At most eight tile fetches are in transit; each resolution’s replan pumps the next batch, and slots freed by an abort are usable in the same plan.

cases.name: stage-less-demand-is-capped-exact
cases.covers: Without a visibleRect the whole page tiles, so the level clamps to keep the whole-page tile count near 64, with a one-time warning.

args: [render] stage-less tile demand of 80000 device px would tile the whole page — clamped to 3600. Supply a visibleRect (host the page in a Stage) for sharp deep zoom.

cases.name: stage-less-demand-is-capped-pyramid
cases.covers: Under a pyramid the stage-less clamp picks the largest rung that fits, or the smallest when none does.

args: [render] stage-less tile demand of 80000 device px would tile the whole page — clamped to 1800. Supply a visibleRect (host the page in a Stage) for sharp deep zoom.

cases.name: stage-less-pyramid-smallest-rung
cases.covers: When no pyramid rung fits the stage-less clamp, the smallest rung is used.

args: [render] stage-less tile demand of 80000 device px would tile the whole page — clamped to 450. Supply a visibleRect (host the page in a Stage) for sharp deep zoom.

cases.name: evicted-tile-bytes-refetch
cases.covers: The store owns the bytes: a resolved tile whose bytes were evicted leaves the paint list on the next plan and is fetched again.

cases.name: base-tiles-ignore-annotation-epochs
cases.covers: Tiles planned without annotations key a0 and version on content only: an annotation invalidate keeps them, a content invalidate drops them.

cases.name: lattice-tiles-block
cases.covers: An advertised tiles block wins: its scales are the pyramid, its first tile size replaces an unlisted one, and the conformed format rides into tile fetches and keys (whose geometry names the option size).

cases.name: lattice-tiles-block-keeps-a-listed-size
cases.covers: A tile size the tiles block lists is kept.

cases.name: client-tile-ladder
cases.covers: A client tile ladder under continuous snaps levels up its rungs, and tile fetches carry the strategy quality.

cases.name: max-scale-clamps-exact-levels
cases.covers: Exact levels clamp at maxScale × page width.

cases.name: prefetch-ring-velocity-bias
cases.covers: The prefetch ring stretches toward the scroll direction; with velocityBias off the ring is symmetric.

cases.name: prefetch-ring-without-bias
cases.covers: velocityBias false ignores the velocity.

cases.name: retained-blocked-diagnostics
cases.covers: With debug on, a retained tile that cannot release says which want tiles block it: missing, pending, or resolved but unpainted.

cases.name: permission-denied-tiles
cases.covers: A denied session’s tile fetches refuse locally with PermissionDenied (context render.tile): no engine calls, each key marked failed, the layers woken.

args: [render] tile failed t:11|w4896|0,0|a1|e0|g512.1: PermissionDenied: permission denied (render.tile): doc.render
[render] tile failed t:11|w4896|1,0|a1|e0|g512.1: PermissionDenied: permission denied (render.tile): doc.render
[render] tile failed t:11|w4896|0,1|a1|e0|g512.1: PermissionDenied: permission denied (render.tile): doc.render
[render] tile failed t:11|w4896|1,1|a1|e0|g512.1: PermissionDenied: permission denied (render.tile): doc.render

cases.name: close-with-tiles-in-flight
cases.covers: Closing the document does not stop the tile manager: an armed settle timer still fires and fetches through the retained handle, late answers still wake, and a plan after close is empty.

cases.name: page-size-change-reuses-width-keys
cases.covers: A page registry update (rotation) changes the page size under a live plan: level identity is the device width, so old-scale tiles share keys with the new grid.

cases.name: plan-throws-when-the-engine-refuses-the-page
cases.covers: A page the registry lists but the handle refuses throws out of plan (doc.page inside the fetch), after the entry was recorded and its slot charged.

cases.name: no-bleed
cases.covers: bleed 0 paints and fetches the logical tile rects; disengaging without debug drops state silently and re-engaging paints from the store.

cases.name: engage-at-option
cases.covers: An explicit engageAt replaces the resolved default.
